observations: Photo 0 shows a PlayStation 5 console standing on a floor/ledge with a white DualSense controller in front; the console appears to be the slim model (taller, slimmer profile).
Photo 1 shows the PS5 console front view with a white DualSense controller in front; no visible game discs.
No clear view of the PS5 model number/serial, storage size, or whether it is the digital vs disc version.
No clear view of included accessories beyond the controller (no cables, box, receipt, or second pad shown).

claims.claim: Clean PS5 slim with a pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PS5 slim and one white controller, but cleanliness/condition (no scratches, fully working) is not provable remotely.

risks.risk: Disc vs Digital version is not confirmed; price can differ depending on whether it has a disc drive.
risks.proof: A photo of the console side/front showing the disc slot (or a close-up of the model label/port area).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case for value: treat as not confirmed disc-capable (i.e., not guaranteed disc version).

risks.risk: Working status is not confirmed (can power on but have faults like overheating, HDMI issues, or controller drift).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on to the home screen + controller pairing + one game launch (or system settings screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/untested until proven.

risks.risk: Storage size (e.g., 825GB vs other) is not shown; affects value.
risks.proof: Photo of System Settings → Storage (or a clear screenshot/photo showing total storage).
risks.if_unproven: Price as the lowest common value configuration until storage is shown.

risks.risk: Included items are unclear: seller says 'with a pad' but photos only show one controller; cables/HDMI/box not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (console, both pads if any, HDMI, power cable, controller charging cable, receipt/box).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console + 1 controller only (no extra cables/box/second pad).

proof_requests: Video: power-on to PS5 home screen + controller connected/working (no error messages).
Photo of the console model label/serial area (for exact variant) and a clear shot of the disc slot/side ports to confirm disc vs digital.
Photo of System Settings → Storage showing total capacity.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (HDMI, power cable, controller charging cable, and confirm whether there is a second pad).
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5 Slim and one controller, but key value drivers (disc vs digital, storage size, and working status) are not provable remotely, so a safe price cannot be set from the provided comparables.
